name: onboarding
description: Use when the current repo has existing code but no Piyaz project that matches it, and the user wants to adopt Piyaz on day N. Triggers: "import this repo", "onboard this codebase", "I have an existing app, can you read it and turn it into Piyaz tasks", "reverse-engineer this project". Do not use when no code exists yet (route to brainstorm), a Piyaz project for this repo already exists (route to manage), or the user has a clean spec but no code (route to decompose).

findings.excerpt: for f in <space-separated paths from all done tasks>; do
